failure.assertion: G18 first accepted head is not the frozen factor-1/2 twice contraction
failure.mechanism: The harness inferred the contraction fraction by subtracting two nearly equal heads and dividing by the small raw-current increment, then applied an unnecessarily tight dimensionless 1e-12 tolerance. The frozen P4 implementation itself performs two sequential factor-1/2 head updates.

repair_contract: Preserve the frozen G11 current, raw and accepted heads and contraction count.
Reconstruct the accepted head by the exact sequential factor-1/2 arithmetic used by P4.
Compare the reconstructed head with the persisted accepted head at floating-point head precision rather than using the ill-conditioned derived alpha as the authority gate.
Do not change the G18 compatibility hypothesis, F-GC38/F-GC39 contract audit, or any production/runtime source.
